title: Devnarayan Post Matric Scholarship Scheme
official_title: Devnarayan Post Matric Scholarship Scheme for MBC Students
administering_authority: Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan
beneficiary_groups: Most Backward Classes (MBC) Students in Rajasthan
summary: Devnarayan Post Matric Scholarship Scheme provides reimbursement of maintenance allowances and non-refundable educational fees to students belonging to notified Most Backward Classes (MBC) in Rajasthan with annual family income up to ₹2,50,000.

benefits.description: Reimbursement of maintenance allowance and compulsory non-refundable fees according to the level and duration of the post-matric course.
conditions: Must be a bonafide native resident of Rajasthan
Must belong to notified Most Backward Classes (Banjara, Baladiya, Labana, Gadia-Lohar, Gadolia, Gurjar/Gujar, Raika/Rebari/Debasi, Gadariya/Gadri/Gayari)
Annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,50,000

rules.explanation: Applicant student must be a bonafide native of Rajasthan.

required_documents.name: Bonafide Resident / Domicile Certificate
required_documents.condition: Proof of permanent residence in Rajasthan

required_documents.name: MBC Caste Certificate
required_documents.condition: Issued by Tehsildar or higher revenue officer

required_documents.name: Income Certificate
required_documents.condition: Certifying total parental/guardian income up to ₹2,50,000

required_documents.name: Fee Receipt & Previous Marksheet
required_documents.condition: Proof of course admission and passing previous examination

required_documents.name: Bank Passbook Copy
required_documents.condition: Student's bank account linked with Jan Aadhaar

application_steps.description: Visit Rajasthan Single Sign-On (SSO) Portal (https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in) and log in using Jan-Aadhaar ID or SSO credentials.
Access the Scholarship (SJMS) application on the SSO dashboard.
Select Devnarayan Post Matric Scholarship and confirm student profile facts.
Upload fee receipt, previous qualifying marksheet, and income certificate.
Submit application for verification by Institution and District Social Justice Officer.
